info.name: Talkpush Agents API Calls API API
Retrieve a list of calls within a date range

params.name: api_key
params.description: The API key provided for your application.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the date range filter. Date format must be DD-MM-YYYY (e.g., 01-02-2026). Required.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the date range filter. Date format must be DD-MM-YYYY (e.g., 13-02-2026). Required.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of the results to return. Default is 1.

items.docs: This endpoint returns a paginated list of calls within the specified date range. Each call record includes the associated app_id. The start_date and end_date parameters are required and must be in DD-MM-YYYY format.
